about_the_game:
The graphics and dialogues in the game are in English. I have translated the important rules here. At the end of the description, there is a reference graphic – please scroll down.

----------------------------------------

The goal of the game is to collect all 45 badges. If you succeed, you'll be added to the online leaderboard. Your final score includes your total points, the number of levels, and the time you spent in the game. The fewer levels and less time you use, the better your rank.

----------------------------------------

Controlls:Left paddle: left shift or “A”

Right paddle: right shift or “L”

Nudging the machine:You can deflect the ball by pressing the space bar.

----------------------------------------

Scoring:

* 1 Rank Ppoint

** 2 Rank Ppoint

*** 3 Rank Ppoint

**** 5 Rank Ppoint

***** 10 Rank Ppoint

1 Badge:

10 Rank Points

Loss of Badge:If you complete the level with only 1 point.

----------------------------------------

Yellow sensor: Level Rebuild. Initiates level reset uponexcessivepoint loss.

Red sensors: Hit-based point deduction. easy -2 / rage -7

Green Sensor: Speed Up. The ball speeds up for a short time and then returns to its original speed.

Pink sensor: Bricks Destroyer. You explode multiple bricks at once and get points for it.

The holes: Hit-based point deduction. (easy and rage -1)

The Teleporter: When the ball falls in, it gets pulled in and then ejected somewhere else after a short time.

Light Blue: Platform Hidden.

Dark Blue: Platform Appears, and Manual control activated for 30 seconds, then reverts to automatic movement.

----------------------------------------

Level design: The purpose of the level design is to let you play in the atmosphere you prefer, while the rules remain the same.

Why? Create custom graphics for yourself or friends. Submissions may be featured as a downloadable pack on the website.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (3rd Generation) or better.
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Integrated Graphics - Any OpenGL 2.0 compatible graphics card
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible or Integrated Audio
  • Additional Notes: CPU-intensive physics engine (Box2D). 1920x1080 resolution is recommended. Higher resolutions (e.g., 4K) require a significantly stronger CPU to maintain accurate physics simulation. Internet connection is only required to save and submit your high scores. The game is otherwise fully playable offline.

short_description: Infinite balls no limits. Avoid the deadly spike or lose your score. Collect 45 evil badges across multiple themes you can switch anytime. Climb the online leaderboard if you dare. Customize graphics, sounds. Join the chaos and make it your own!
